result.summary: Analysis identifies two primary visual concerns regarding loading indicators and text layout.

issues.description: A loading spinner is permanently visible over the ramen restaurant image.
issues.suggestion: Optimize image loading or ensure the spinner disappears after a timeout.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Picco' is truncated in the horizontal scroll section.
issues.suggestion: Increase the container size or implement text wrapping for long titles.
